description: A comprehensive database management project designed to help law enforcement agencies track and manage crime reports, witnesses, suspects, and evidence.

core_features.name: Officer Authentication
core_features.description: Secure login system for officers using email and password to access the dashboard.

core_features.name: Crime Dashboard
core_features.description: Centralized view of all crimes with real-time searching by type or location.

core_features.name: Crime CRUD Operations
core_features.description: Full ability to Add, Read, Update, and Delete crime records including location, date, and descriptions.

core_features.name: Witness Management
core_features.description: Associate multiple witnesses with a single crime, storing their names and official statements.

core_features.name: Suspect Tracking
core_features.description: Maintain a list of suspects for each crime with detailed physical descriptions.

core_features.name: Evidence Cataloging
core_features.description: Log physical evidence with descriptions, where it was found, and the date it was recovered.

core_features.name: Data Integrity
core_features.description: Uses foreign key constraints and cascaded deletes to ensure database consistency (e.g., deleting a crime removes associated evidence).

file_architecture.role: Entry point and GUI handling (Login window, Dashboard, Detail windows).
Centralized database configuration and connection management.
Business logic and Data Access Layer containing all SQL queries.
Auxiliary module for specialized user/officer tasks.
